name: tatra-labs/cram
title: cram: test-time training shrinks a long document's KV cache 8x while keeping 90% recall
summary: Instead of evicting cache entries, cram trains a compact KV cache on a document once; at 8x compression Qwen3 keeps 90% of phonebook lookups versus 5% with eviction. Open-source code implements the linked paper.
